stem: You are the transplant coordinator on call for organ offer management. A 61-year-old liver transplant patient is the focus of today's interaction. The candidate completed initial screening last week. The candidate is anxious and requests a clear, reference-based explanation. Which cardiac test is included in the standard pre-transplant evaluation workup for adult liver transplant candidates?

options.text: Echocardiogram and/or cardiac stress testing
Routine coronary bypass surgery before listing
Cardiac catheterization for every candidate regardless of symptoms
No cardiac assessment unless the candidate has chest pain

explanation.rationale_correct: Liver candidate evaluation includes echocardiogram and/or cardiac stress testing (dynamic or nuclear) as part of cardiac assessment before transplant.

rationale_incorrect.B: Surgical coronary revascularization is not a universal listing requirement for all liver candidates.
rationale_incorrect.C: Catheterization may be used when indicated, but the standard workup lists echocardiogram and/or stress testing—not mandatory catheterization for all.
rationale_incorrect.D: Cardiac assessment is part of the structured pre-transplant evaluation, not deferred until symptomatic chest pain occurs.

stem: You are the transplant coordinator supporting the multidisciplinary selection meeting. A 48-year-old kidney transplant patient is the focus of today's interaction. rationale_incorrect.B: Inactive status applies to candidates awaiting transplant, not to recipients who have already been transplanted.
rationale_incorrect.C: UNOS policy changes have allowed waiting time accrual for some inactive periods; inactive status does not automatically erase all waiting time.
rationale_incorrect.D: Inactive listing is often temporary while issues are resolved, not a permanent declaration of ineligibility.
